highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and delivers compiler XML documentation with updated HarfBuzz bindings.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp now follows the bundled native source during generation. Code using the corrected combining-class enum name needs a small source update.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was corrected to CCC132
breaking.body: The upstream name is now reflected in HarfBuzzSharp while preserving numeric value 132. Replace source references to CCC133 with CCC132.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer available
breaking.body: Aggregate Defined masks are not exposed because they are not independent options. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your code instead.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates current upstream bug and buffer-upload fixes.

bullets.lead: Compiler XML documentation shipped with packages
bullets.detail: Package consumers receive compiler-generated XML documentation sourced from C# API comments.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz bindings generated from bundled source
bullets.detail: Keeps HarfBuzzSharp bindings synchronized with the HarfBuzz revision used to build the bundled native library.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Scoped HarfBuzzSharp compiler-warning suppression to resolve native binary analysis findings

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp now generates bindings from the DEPS-pinned native source and corrects the CCC132 enum name while keeping unsupported callback-heavy APIs out of the managed surface.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It also begins the transition to compiler XML documentation and DEPS-pinned HarfBuzz bindings.
